520	Yonatan says, "Father, enough.	Yonatan diz: "Pai, chega.
521	Father, calm down, what happened?	Pai, acalme-se, o que aconteceu?
522	Whoever is meant to be king will be king. Enough.	Quem deve ser rei, será rei. Chega.

527	At David.	De David.
528	Yonatan understands that the storm has settled on the king's face.	Yonatan entende que a tempestade tomou o rosto do rei.
